name: usage-gauge
description: (superseded by rd-ledger) A live cost chip in the prompt footer and a /spend Usage pane: the session's cost, context by category, rate limits, tokens and cache hit per model, subagent share and code changes, without /usage landing in the transcript.

footerButton.title: Clickable footer chip
footerButton.description: Draw the footer figure as a button that opens the Usage pane (the desktop draws every button as a grey chip). Off, the figure is plain text and /spend opens the pane.

chipContext.title: Context in the chip
chipContext.description: Also show the context window's fill in the chip ('$123 · ctx 12%'). Off by default: the desktop's footer strip truncates every chip to '…' once they overflow it, and the context figure is a click away in the pane.
